summary.headline: Hellenic Month Names and Seasons
summary.text: List of Hellenic month names from the Book of Glosses, identified with January through December and linked to Augustus, Agrippa, Livia, Octavia, Julia, Nero, Drusus, Venus, Anchises, Roma, Aeneas, and the Capitol. The discussion then compares the dodecaeteris month order and codex notices on sowing and the winter solstice in different zodiacal years.
